ONNX Runtime Web distribution
=============================

Files in this directory are unmodified distributable assets from
onnxruntime-web version 1.30.0:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web/v/1.30.0
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
Licensed under the MIT License.

The extension uses only the WebAssembly execution provider through the
packaged `ort.wasm.min.js`, `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs`, and
`ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm` files. Source maps and unused execution
providers are intentionally not included.
